headline: Weathered Expanse Erupts Anew As Mooring County Sustains Fierce Churn
war_summary: Farranac Coast has abruptly subsided into quiet following its midday convulsions, logging no base turnovers and sharply diminished casualty rates over the past two hours. In contrast, the northern front has erupted into renewed mobility across Weathered Expanse, where intense fighting produced six strategic base transitions within two hours—centered around Crow's Nest and Frostmarch—while consuming more than four thousand combined casualties. Mooring County remains locked in relentless churn, posting seven further base captures and losses across Gravekeeper's Holdfast and The Cut alongside another three thousand fallen soldiers. To the east, Stlican Shelf continues its active duel with three base shifts between Fort Hoarfrost and The Pale House, leaving one position reduced to no-man's-land. Elsewhere along the line, Callahan's Passage and the Dead Lands sustain mounting butcher's bills under accelerating combat tempo without any alteration of strategic base lines, while Stonecradle lingers in relative stillness after its earlier overhauls.
